setup_distributed_process_group: setup a PyTorch distributed process group for SLURM or local multi-GPU training using a config dict
get_init_method_tcp_or_file: get a TCP or file-based initialization method string for a distributed job with world size and rank
all_reduce_tensor_across_ranks: perform an all-reduce operation on a tensor across all ranks with optional averaging enabled
gather_objects_to_master_rank: gather pickleable objects from all ranks into a list on the master rank using dist gather_object
cleanup_distributed_and_ray: cleanup the distributed process group, shutdown Ray, and release GPU resources with proper port release delay
